findings.priority: P1 candidate limited to public checkpoint helper reproducibility; normal documented float32 CLI path passed
findings.trigger: Save TimeMLP().double() or ConditionalConvFlow().double() with first weight 1+2^-25, then load with default float32; alternatively change ambient torch default dtype before loading a valid float32 checkpoint.
findings.observed: Both helpers silently adopt the ambient default dtype on construction. float64 1.0000000298023224 becomes float32 1.0; valid float32 checkpoints become float64 when ambient default is float64. strict=True also silently accepts/casts same-shaped int64 state; NaN state loads.
findings.impact: Saved tensor precision/representation need not match the returned inference model. Existing exact-roundtrip tests cover only the default float32 case.
findings.limit: No default reader CLI failure or false successful metrics reproduced. Nonfinite outputs are rejected later by diagnostics.
findings.minimal_fix: Make schema-1 dtype contract explicit. Preserve current CPU float32 artifacts by validating state mapping/tensor dtype/finiteness at save and load, constructing the model explicitly as float32, and retaining strict shape/key checks. If float64 is supported instead, preserve declared dtype consistently through model and sampler input creation.
